name: Scholar's Mate
setup: e4 e5 Bc4 Nc6 Qh5 Nf6
idea: Queen and bishop both aim at f7. Black just attacked your queen instead of covering it.

lines.label: Mate on f7
lines.note: The classic four-move mate. Only the king defended f7.

name: Légal's Mate
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 d6 Bc4 Bg4 Nc3 g6
idea: Black's bishop pins your knight to the queen. The pin is fake: give up the queen.

lines.label: Black grabs the queen
lines.note: Bishop and two knights deliver mate. The queen was bait.

lines.label: Black takes the knight
lines.note: Black sees the danger, but Qxg4 wins back the piece and you stay a clean pawn up.

name: Damiano Punishment
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 f6
idea: 2...f6 weakens the e8–h5 diagonal. Sacrifice a piece to exploit it.

lines.moves: Nxe5 fxe5 Qh5+ g6 Qxe5+ Qe7 Qxh8
lines.label: Black blocks with ...g6
lines.note: The queen forks king and rook. You win the exchange plus two pawns.

lines.moves: Nxe5 fxe5 Qh5+ Ke7 Qxe5+ Kf7
lines.label: Black walks the king
lines.note: The king is dragged into the open. Bc4+ or Qd5+ next and the attack is decisive.

lines.label: Black declines the knight
lines.note: Black regains the pawn, but the queen is exposed and you are well ahead in development.

name: Hanham Trap
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 d6 d4 Nd7 Bc4 Ngf6
idea: Open the centre. With the d-file and f7 both weak, Black's queen and king run out of room.

lines.label: Black recaptures with the pawn
lines.note: Ng5 hits f7 twice and Black can't hold it. Nxf7 or Bxf7+ wins material next.

lines.moves: dxe5 Nxe5 Nxe5 dxe5 Bxf7+ Kxf7 Qxd8
lines.label: Black recaptures with the knight, then takes on f7
lines.note: The bishop check opens the d-file and the black queen falls.

lines.moves: dxe5 Nxe5 Nxe5 dxe5 Bxf7+ Ke7
lines.label: Black recaptures with the knight, king steps up
lines.note: Black keeps the queen. Trade queens with Qxd8+ and you're a clean pawn up.

name: Philidor f7 Trap
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 d6 d4 Nd7 Bc4 Be7
idea: Black's last move blocked nothing important. Open lines toward f7.

lines.label: Black recaptures with the pawn, ...Nh6
lines.note: Qd5 threatens mate on f7. After ...Nh6 the defender is simply taken.

lines.moves: dxe5 dxe5 Qd5 Bb4+ c3 Qe7 cxb4
lines.label: Black recaptures with the pawn, ...Bb4+
lines.note: The check runs out of steam. You collect the bishop.

lines.moves: dxe5 Nxe5 Nxe5 dxe5 Qh5 g6 Qxe5
lines.label: Black recaptures with the knight
lines.note: Qh5 hits f7 and e5 at once. You win a pawn and keep the attack.

name: Opera Game Trap
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 d6 d4 Bg4 dxe5 Bxf3 Qxf3 dxe5 Bc4 Nf6
idea: Morphy's idea from the Opera Game (1858): one queen move attacks two weak pawns.

lines.label: Black guards f7 with the queen
lines.note: b7 falls and the a8 rook is next. Morphy preferred Nc3, keeping the attack going.

lines.label: Black guards f7 with the queen
lines.note: Morphy's choice: develop first, the b7 pawn isn't going anywhere.

lines.label: Black counterattacks with ...Bc5
lines.note: You've taken f7 with check. The black king can never castle and you're a pawn up.

name: Petrov Copycat Trap
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 Nf6 Nxe5 Nxe4
idea: Black copied your capture. The e-file is about to open against the black king.

lines.label: Black retreats the knight
lines.note: Nc6+ is a discovered check that also attacks d8. The queen falls.

lines.label: Black retreats the knight
lines.note: Nc6+ is a discovered check that also attacks d8. The queen falls.

lines.label: Black defends the knight with ...d5
lines.note: The e4 knight is pinned to the king and cannot be saved.

lines.label: Best defence: Black mirrors you
lines.note: Material is level, but Black lost time with the queen. A small edge for you.

name: Blackburne Shilling Gambit
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bc4 Nd4 Nxe5
idea: White grabbed the e5 pawn. Hit two targets at once.

lines.moves: Qg5 Nxf7 Qxg2 Rf1 Qxe4+ Be2 Nf3#
lines.label: White forks f7
lines.note: Smothered-style mate with the knight on f3.

lines.label: Best defence: White checks first
lines.note: After …Kd8 you collect the e5 knight. A piece for two pawns: you're slightly better.

lines.label: White retreats to g4
lines.note: …d5 hits the bishop and opens your bishop onto g4. White loses material.

name: Two Knights Greed Punished
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bc4 Nf6 Ng5 Nxe4
idea: Black took a pawn instead of defending f7.

lines.moves: Bxf7+ Ke7 d4 h6 Nxe4 Kxf7 d5
lines.label: Black's king must step up
lines.note: The black king has lost castling and stands in the open. You regain the piece with a big edge.

name: Stafford Gambit Trap
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 Nf6 Nxe5 Nc6 Nxc6 dxc6 d3 Bc5 Bg5
idea: White pins your knight to your queen. Ignore the pin and attack f2.

lines.label: White takes the queen
lines.note: Bishop mate on g4. White was a queen up for one move.

lines.label: White takes the knight
lines.note: The open d-file hands you White's queen.

lines.label: White retreats the bishop
lines.note: You're a pawn up and the white king is under fire.

name: Stafford e5 Trap
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 Nf6 Nxe5 Nc6 Nxc6 dxc6 e5 Ne4 d3
idea: White is chasing your knight. Let it go and aim at f2 instead.

lines.label: White takes the knight
lines.note: The d-file opened and White's queen drops.

lines.moves: Bc5 Be3 Bxe3 fxe3 Qh4+ g3 Nxg3 hxg3 Qxh1
lines.label: White blocks with Be3
lines.note: The kingside collapses and you collect the h1 rook.

name: Classical King's Gambit Trap
setup: e4 e5 f4 Bc5 fxe5
idea: White took on e5 and left the e1–h4 diagonal open.

lines.label: White blocks with g3
lines.note: The queen check forks king and rook. You win the h1 rook.

lines.label: White blocks with g3
lines.note: The queen check forks king and rook. You win the h1 rook.

lines.label: White moves the king
lines.note: Every escape square is covered. Mate.

name: Vienna Queen Raid
setup: e4 e5 Nc3 Nc6 Bc4 Bc5 Qg4 Nf6
idea: Black attacked your queen but left g7 hanging.

lines.label: Black saves the rook
lines.note: You've won a pawn and Black can't castle kingside.

lines.label: Black sacrifices on f2
lines.note: The desperado gets one pawn back but you're a piece up.

lines.label: Black counterattacks with ...d5
lines.note: Too slow: Qxh8+ or Nxd5 wins a whole rook.

name: Tarrasch Trap
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bb5 d6 d4 Bd7 Nc3 Nf6 O-O Be7 Re1 O-O
idea: Black castled too early. The e5 pawn is pinned in a way Black hasn't noticed.

lines.moves: Bxc6 Bxc6 dxe5 dxe5 Qxd8 Raxd8 Nxe5 Bxe4 Nxe4 Nxe4 Nd3 f5 f3 Bc5+ Nxc5 Nxc5 Bg5
lines.label: The main trap line
lines.note: After the trades the Bg5 skewer wins material along the d- and e-files.

lines.moves: Bxc6 Bxc6 dxe5 Ng4 exd6 Bxd6
lines.label: Best defence: ...Ng4
lines.note: Black avoids the trap. You're simply a pawn up.

lines.label: Black takes on d4
lines.note: Black ignores the bishop and loses a piece.

name: Mortimer Trap
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bb5 Nf6 d3 Ne7 Nxe5
idea: White grabbed e5. Both the knight and the bishop are loose.

lines.label: The bishop retreats
lines.note: The queen check forks king and knight.

lines.label: The bishop retreats
lines.note: The queen check forks king and knight.

lines.label: The knight retreats to c4
lines.note: Careful: …cxb5? allows Nd6 mate! Play …d6 or …Ng6 first and the bishop is still lost.

lines.moves: c6 Nxf7 Kxf7 Bc4+ d5 Bb3
lines.label: Best defence: White sacrifices on f7
lines.note: Two pawns for the piece. You stay clearly better.

name: Noah's Ark Trap
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bb5 a6 Ba4 d6 d4 b5 Bb3 Nxd4 Nxd4 exd4 Qxd4
idea: White's bishop on b3 has very few squares. Take them away.

lines.moves: c5 Qd5 Be6 Qc6+ Bd7 Qd5 c4
lines.label: White's queen checks
lines.note: …c4 traps the b3 bishop: the ark closes.

lines.label: White's queen retreats
lines.note: The bishop has nowhere to go.

lines.label: White retreats at once
lines.note: a4 and c2 are covered and the bishop is lost.

name: Fishing Pole Trap
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bb5 Nf6 O-O Ng4 h3 h5 hxg4
idea: White took the bait. Open the h-file toward the white king.

lines.label: White retreats to h2
lines.note: The queen and rook line up on the h-file. Mate is close.

lines.label: White retreats to e1
lines.note: Now …g3 (or …Bc5+) and mate on h2 or h1 can't be stopped.

lines.label: Best defence: White ignores the knight
lines.note: Take on f3 next and you're a piece up with an open h-file.

name: Exchange Ruy h-file Trap
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bb5 a6 Bxc6 dxc6 O-O Bg4 h3 h5 hxg4
idea: White took your bishop. Recapture and the h-file is yours.

lines.label: White grabs e5
lines.note: Now …g3 leaves no defence to mate on h2 or h1.

lines.label: White grabs e5
lines.note: Now …g3 leaves no defence to mate on h2 or h1.

lines.label: Best defence: White gives the piece back
lines.note: You keep a lasting initiative on the kingside.

name: Marshall Trap
setup: e4 e5 Nf3 Nf6 Nxe5 d6 Nf3 Nxe4 d4 d5 Bd3 Bd6 O-O O-O c4 Bg4 cxd5 f5 Re1
idea: White's rook left f2 thin. Strip the king.

lines.moves: Bxh2+ Kxh2 Nxf2 Qe2 Nxd3 Qxd3 Bxf3 Qxf3 Qh4+ Kg1 Qxe1+
lines.label: White recaptures on d3
lines.note: The h4 check forks king and the e1 rook. You come out a rook ahead.

lines.label: White takes with the knight
lines.note: The queen falls.

lines.moves: Bxh2+ Kxh2 Nxf2 Qe2 Nxd3 Qe6+ Kh8
lines.label: Best defence: Qe6+
lines.note: White avoids the worst. You stay a pawn up with the safer king.

name: Magnus Smith Trap
setup: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 d4 cxd4 Nxd4 Nf6 Nc3 Nc6 Bc4 g6 Nxc6 bxc6
idea: Black's f7 and d-file are both soft. Push into the centre.

lines.label: Black takes on e5
lines.note: The bishop check uncovers the d-file. Black's queen falls.

lines.label: Black counterattacks with ...d5
lines.note: You come out a piece ahead.

lines.label: Best defence: ...Ng4
lines.note: Black found the only good reply. Keep developing; you're slightly better.

name: Siberian Trap
setup: e4 c5 d4 cxd4 c3 dxc3 Nxc3 Nc6 Nf3 e6 Bc4 Qc7 O-O Nf6 Qe2 Ng4 h3
idea: Your queen and knight both eye h2. Remove the one defender.

lines.label: White takes the knight
lines.note: The f3 knight was the only guard on h2.

lines.label: White saves the queen
lines.note: Take the f3 guard with check first, then mate on h2.

lines.label: White saves the queen
lines.note: Take the f3 guard with check first, then mate on h2.

lines.label: White takes the g4 knight
lines.note: No mate, but you win the queen for a knight.

name: Najdorf Fork-Trick Fail
setup: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 d4 cxd4 Nxd4 Nf6 Nc3 a6 Bc4 e5 Nde2 Nxe4 Nxe4 d5 Bxd5 Qxd5
idea: Black's fork trick has a hole in it. Look along the d-file.

lines.label: Black's queen is loose
lines.note: The black queen was undefended on the open d-file.

name: Advance French Queen Trap
setup: e4 e6 d4 d5 e5 c5 c3 Nc6 Nf3 Qb6 Bd3 cxd4 cxd4 Nxd4 Nxd4 Qxd4
idea: Black's queen grabbed d4. It is lined up with your queen on the d-file.

lines.label: Black blocks with the bishop
lines.note: The bishop check clears the way for Qxd4.

lines.label: Black blocks with the bishop
lines.note: The bishop check clears the way for Qxd4.

lines.label: Black moves the king
lines.note: The king steps aside and the queen is lost.

lines.label: Black moves the king
lines.note: The king steps aside and the queen is lost.

name: Smothered Knight Mate
setup: e4 c6 d4 d5 Nc3 dxe4 Nxe4 Nd7 Qe2 Ngf6
idea: Your queen on e2 pins the e7 pawn. Black's last move took the king's only spare square.

lines.label: Instant mate
lines.note: The e7 pawn is pinned, so it cannot capture. Mate on move six.

name: Réti–Tartakower Mate
setup: e4 c6 d4 d5 Nc3 dxe4 Nxe4 Nf6 Qd3 e5 dxe5 Qa5+ Bd2 Qxe5 O-O-O Nxe4
idea: Vienna, 1910. The d-file is open and Black's king hasn't moved. Give everything.

lines.label: The king runs to c7
lines.note: A queen sacrifice and a double check. Bishop mate on d8.

lines.label: The king runs to e8
lines.note: The rook finishes on d8.

name: Deep Blue's Sacrifice
setup: e4 c6 d4 d5 Nc3 dxe4 Nxe4 Nd7 Ng5 Ngf6 Bd3 e6 N1f3 h6
idea: Deep Blue vs Kasparov, game 6, 1997. Black's ...h6 was one move too slow.

lines.moves: Nxe6 Qe7 O-O fxe6 Bg6+ Kd8 Bf4
lines.label: As in the game: ...Qe7
lines.note: Kasparov resigned soon after. The black king is stuck in the centre.

lines.label: Black takes at once
lines.note: The king is pinned down in the open. Your attack is worth far more than the piece.

lines.label: Black checks first
lines.note: The knight on e6 is still attacking and Black's position is falling apart.

name: Two Knights f7 Strike
setup: e4 c6 Nc3 d5 Nf3 dxe4 Nxe4 Bf5 Ng3 Bg6 h4 h6 Ne5 Bh7 Qh5 g6 Bc4 e6 Qe2 Nf6
idea: Black's last move left f7 defended only by the king.

lines.label: Black saves the queen
lines.note: The knight forks queen and rook and takes on h8.

lines.label: Black takes the knight
lines.note: The bishop on c4 supports mate on f7.

name: Hillbilly Attack Trap
setup: e4 c6 Bc4 d5 Bb3 dxe4 Qh5 Nf6
idea: Queen and bishop are both aimed at f7.

lines.label: The king must run
lines.note: Not mate, but the king is stuck in the open and you are a pawn up with a big attack.

name: Owen's Defense Trap
setup: e4 b6 d4 Bb7 Bd3 f5
idea: Black played ...f5 with the king still on e8.

lines.moves: exf5 Bxg2 Qh5+ g6 fxg6 Nf6 gxh7+ Nxh5 Bg6#
lines.label: Black attacks the queen
lines.note: Pawn and bishop finish the job.

lines.moves: exf5 Bxg2 Qh5+ g6 fxg6 Bg7 gxh7+ Kf8
lines.label: Black develops ...Bg7
lines.note: Black will win the h1 rook, but your attack and the h7 pawn are worth far more.

name: Nimzowitsch Légal Trap
setup: e4 Nc6 Nf3 d6 d4 Bg4 d5 Ne5
idea: Like Légal's Mate: the pin on your knight is not real.

lines.moves: Nxe5 Bxd1 Bb5+ c6 dxc6 a6 c7+ axb5 cxd8=Q+ Rxd8 Nxf7
lines.label: Black takes the queen
lines.note: Pawn promotion and a fork give you more than the queen back.

lines.label: Black takes the knight
lines.note: You simply win the bishop.

lines.label: Black retreats the bishop
lines.note: You're simply a piece up.

name: Alekhine Knight Trap
setup: e4 Nf6 e5 Ne4 d3 Nc5 d4 Ne4
idea: Black's knight has wandered into the centre and has no retreat.

lines.label: The knight runs to g5
lines.note: The knight is trapped and lost.

lines.label: Black ignores the threat
lines.note: You're a full piece up.

name: Anti-Scholar's Fork
setup: e4 e5 Qh5 Nc6 Bc4 g6 Qf3 Nf6 g4
idea: White keeps threatening f7 but left c2 and the queen loose.

lines.label: White retreats the queen
lines.note: Now …d5 or …Nxe4 and White's position falls apart.

lines.label: White keeps the queen active
lines.note: The knight forks king and rook and takes on a1.

name: Anti-Scholar's Fork II
setup: e4 e5 Qh5 Nc6 Bc4 g6 Qf3 Nf6 Qb3
idea: White's queen now hits f7. Answer with tempo.

lines.label: White moves the queen
lines.note: You win the e4 pawn and White's pieces are scattered.

lines.label: White takes on f7
lines.note: The bishop on f7 is trapped: …b5 or …c6 next wins it.

name: Halosar Trap
setup: d4 d5 e4 dxe4 Nc3 Nf6 f3 exf3 Qxf3 Qxd4 Be3 Qb4 O-O-O Bg4
idea: Black attacks your queen. Ignore it and aim at c7.

lines.label: Black takes the queen
lines.note: Nxc7 is mate: the rook on d1 covers d7 and d8.

lines.label: Black guards c7
lines.note: b7 falls with a double attack on the a6 knight and a8 rook.

name: Elephant Trap
setup: d4 d5 c4 e6 Nc3 Nf6 Bg5 Nbd7 cxd5 exd5 Nxd5
idea: White thinks your f6 knight is pinned. It isn't.

lines.label: White takes the queen
lines.note: Take back on d2 or d8: either way you win the queen back and end up a knight ahead.

lines.label: White saves the bishop
lines.note: Your queen now hits g5, so White retreats. You collect a second piece.

name: Lasker Trap
setup: d4 d5 c4 e5 dxe5 d4 e3
idea: White challenges your d4 pawn. Use a check to change the target.

lines.moves: Bb4+ Bd2 dxe3 Bxb4 exf2+ Ke2 fxg1=N+ Ke1 Qh4+
lines.label: Ke2, then Ke1
lines.note: Underpromotion to a knight with check. The white king is stuck.

lines.moves: Bb4+ Bd2 dxe3 Bxb4 exf2+ Ke2 fxg1=N+ Rxg1 Bg4+
lines.label: Ke2, then Rxg1
lines.note: The bishop check wins the white queen.

lines.moves: Bb4+ Bd2 dxe3 Bxb4 exf2+ Kxf2 Qxd1
lines.label: White takes on f2
lines.note: The d-file opened. You win the queen.

lines.moves: Bb4+ Bd2 dxe3 fxe3 Qh4+ g3 Qe4
lines.label: Best defence: White recaptures on e3
lines.note: White avoided the trap. The queen hits e3 and h1 and you win back your pawn, but the game is level.

name: Queen's Gambit Accepted Trap
setup: d4 d5 c4 dxc4 e3 b5
idea: Black is trying to hold the extra pawn with ...b5. Undermine it.

lines.label: Black defends with ...c6
lines.note: The long diagonal opens and the a8 rook falls.

lines.label: Black defends with ...a6
lines.note: The a-file opens and you win the rook.

lines.label: Best defence: ...b4
lines.note: You will win back c4 with a comfortable game.

name: Kieninger Trap
setup: d4 Nf6 c4 e5 dxe5 Ng4 Bf4 Nc6 Nf3 Bb4+ Nbd2 Qe7 a3
idea: White wants your bishop. Let them take it.

lines.label: White takes the bishop
lines.note: Smothered mate. The pinned d2 knight blocks the king's escape.

lines.label: Best defence: White trades knights
lines.note: White avoids mate. You've regained the gambit pawn and the game is level.

name: Fajarowicz Trap
setup: d4 Nf6 c4 e5 dxe5 Ne4 Nf3 d6 exd6 Bxd6 g3
idea: White's g3 left f2 with only the king to defend it, and the d-file is open.

lines.label: White takes the knight
lines.note: Deflect the king, then the queen on d1 hangs.

lines.label: White takes the knight
lines.note: Deflect the king, then the queen on d1 hangs.

lines.moves: Nxf2 Kxf2 Bc5+ Ke1 Bf2+ Kxf2 Qxd1
lines.label: White takes the knight
lines.note: Deflect the king, then the queen on d1 hangs.

lines.label: White counterattacks with Qd4
lines.note: You're up the exchange and White's attack fizzles.

name: Englund Gambit Trap
setup: d4 e5 dxe5 Nc6 Nf3 Qe7 Bf4
idea: White's bishop left the queenside. Find the forcing check.

lines.moves: Qb4+ Bd2 Qxb2 Bc3 Bb4 Qd2 Bxc3 Qxc3 Qc1#
lines.label: White plays Bc3
lines.note: The queen lands on c1 with mate.

lines.moves: Qb4+ Bd2 Qxb2 Bc3 Bb4 Qd2 Bxc3 Nxc3 Qxa1+
lines.label: White recaptures with the knight
lines.note: No mate, but you win the a1 rook.

lines.label: White blocks with the knight
lines.note: The bishop on f4 was left hanging. You win a piece.

name: Dutch h-file Mate
setup: d4 f5 Bg5 h6 Bh4 g5 Bg3 f4 e3 h5 Bd3 Rh6
idea: Black's pawn storm left the e8–h5 diagonal and g6 wide open.

lines.label: Black takes the queen
lines.note: Bishop mate on g6.

lines.label: Black blocks with the rook
lines.note: Take on g6 with mate.

lines.label: Black blocks with the rook
lines.note: Take on g6 with mate.

name: Fool's Mate
setup: f3 e5 g4
idea: White has opened the e1–h4 diagonal.

lines.label: Mate in two
lines.note: The fastest possible checkmate.

name: From's Gambit Mate
setup: f4 e5 fxe5 d6 exd6 Bxd6 Nc3
idea: White forgot Nf3. The h4–e1 diagonal is open.

lines.label: Mate on g3
lines.note: Queen and bishop combine against the bare king.

lines.label: Mate on g3
lines.note: Queen and bishop combine against the bare king.

name: Morra Pin-Breaker
setup: e4 c5 d4 cxd4 c3 dxc3 Nxc3 Nc6 Nf3 d6 Bc4 Bg4
idea: Black pinned your knight. A check on f7 breaks the pin and the g4 bishop is left hanging.

lines.label: Black takes on f7
lines.note: The knight check unpins with tempo and Qxg4 nets a pawn and the bishop pair, with Black's king stuck.

lines.label: Black takes on f7
lines.note: The knight check unpins with tempo and Qxg4 nets a pawn and the bishop pair, with Black's king stuck.

lines.label: Black declines the bishop
lines.note: You're a pawn up and Black's king has lost castling. Castle and keep attacking.

name: Dragon Knight-Raid Trap
setup: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 d4 cxd4 Nxd4 Nf6 Nc3 g6 Be3 Ng4
idea: Black's knight jumped to g4 to hit your bishop. It has no defender.

lines.label: Black blocks with the bishop
lines.note: The check distracts the d7 square and your queen collects the g4 knight.

lines.label: Black blocks with the knight
lines.note: The check distracts the d7 square and your queen collects the g4 knight.

lines.moves: Bb5+ Nc6 Nxc6 bxc6 Bxc6+ Bd7
lines.label: Black blocks with ...Nc6
lines.note: The bishop forks the rook on a8. Take it next and you're winning.

name: Levenfish Knight Trap
setup: e4 c5 Nf3 d6 d4 cxd4 Nxd4 Nf6 Nc3 g6 f4 Bg7 e5 dxe5 fxe5 Nd5
idea: Black's knight landed on d5, where it is defended only by the queen. Cut that line.

lines.label: Black blocks with the bishop
lines.note: The check blocks the queen's defence of d5. You come out a piece ahead.

lines.label: Black blocks with the knight
lines.note: The d7 knight cuts off the queen. The d5 knight falls.

lines.label: Black moves the king
lines.note: Black can never castle and the d5 knight still needs help. Castle or play Qf3 and you're close to winning.

name: London Queen Raid
setup: d4 d5 Bf4 c5 e3 Qb6 Nc3 Qxb2
idea: Black's queen grabbed b2 and left d5 and c7 weak.

lines.label: Black develops ...Nf6
lines.note: Rb1 shuts the queen out and Nc7+ forks king and rook.

lines.label: Black takes on d4
lines.note: Rb1 or Bb5+ next: the queen is nearly trapped and Nc7+ is coming.

name: London Queen-Trade Trap
setup: d4 d5 Bf4 c5 e3 Nc6 c3 Qb6 Qb3 c4 Qxb6 axb6 Na3
idea: White's knight went to a3, a square your rook is already looking at.

lines.label: White takes the pawn
lines.note: Now …Rxa3 wins back the piece with an extra pawn.

lines.moves: e5 Bxe5 Bxa3 bxa3 Nxe5 dxe5 Rxa3
lines.label: Best defence: White takes with the bishop
lines.note: You trade into an endgame a pawn up.

lines.moves: e5 Nb5 Ra5 Nc7+ Kd8 Nxd5 Rxd5
lines.label: White's knight runs to b5
lines.note: The knight escapes but White's queenside is a mess. You're better.

name: London b7 Grab
setup: d4 d5 Bf4 Nf6 e3 c5 c3 Nc6 Nd2 Bg4 Qb3 c4
idea: Black closed the queenside with tempo, but forgot what was hanging.

lines.label: Black tries to trap the queen
lines.note: The queen slips out via c7 and you're a pawn up.

lines.label: Black guards c6 with the rook
lines.note: You're a clean pawn up and the b-file belongs to you.

name: Alekhine f7 Sacrifice
setup: e4 Nf6 e5 Nd5 d4 d6 Nf3 dxe5 Nxe5 Nd7
idea: Black offered a knight trade but the d5 knight is loose and the king is thin.

lines.label: Best defence: the king walks
lines.note: The black king is stuck on e6 in the middle of the board. You have a big attack for the piece.

lines.label: Black blocks with ...g6
lines.note: The loose d5 knight falls with check. You're winning.

lines.label: Black steps to f6
